photo.alt: Cook Islands seen from the International Space Station
photo.credit: Earth Science and Remote Sensing Unit, Lyndon B. Johnson Space Center, Public domain, via Wikimedia Commons

worth_knowing: Self-governing, but in free association with New Zealand. Most Cook Islanders hold New Zealand citizenship, and a larger population of Cook Islanders lives in New Zealand and Australia.
